subject: Important Update: Company Policy Changes
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to inform you about the recent changes in our company policies regarding remote work and attendance. Effective immediately, we are implementing a new policy that requires all employees to fill out a daily attendance form by 9:00 AM. This will help us track everyone's availability and ensure smooth operations. Please read the updated policy document attached to this email for more details. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
